messages:
chris: Quick heads up — we need to open an Azure quota + capacity request for NDv4 and ND40rs in northeurope for the staging-dedicated pool. Target start for reserved capacity is 2026-06-01. Can someone own the Azure ticket and follow through with capacity reservation? INC-2042

nina: region/sku/count? also do we need a capacity reservation (CR) or just quota increase for on-demand?

raj: Proposed numbers from planning:
- NDv4 (H100 equiv) instances: 8 (we're asking quota for 8 vms to start, might scale to 12 later)
- ND40rs (A100-style) instances: 6
So initial GPU quota bump: total ~14 GPU VMs across both SKUs. We'll request a capacity reservation for 8 NDv4 + 4 ND40rs for the first 3 months.

sam: Also note the staging subnet is hitting ephemeral port exhaustion on heavy perf tests. Need to request increased outbound SNAT ports / vNet NAT gateway limits for that subscription. Current socket exhaustion observed in load test logs.

chris: Good catch @sam — include vnet/nat port lift in the support payload. We need ports bumped to ~120k ephemeral ports for that NAT gateway for the cluster.

raj: Filing details I'm going to include in the support request:
- Subscription: redwood-prod-eu (xxxx-xxxx-xxxx)
- Resource group: infra-ml-staging
- Location: northeurope
- SKUs: NDv4 (x8), ND40rs (x6)
- Capacity reservation: yes for NDv4 x8 + ND40rs x4 from 2026-06-01 to 2026-09-01
- Additional: NAT gateway outbound ports to 120000, Increase vNet / NSG ephemeral port range if needed
- Business justification: on-prem migration pilot and performance benchmark runs for dedicated customers, SLA commitments for Dedicated product customers.

infra-bot: Support ticket created: AZ-SR-2026-045678 — Azure will validate SKU availability and regional capacity. Internal tracker AZ-QUOTA-6791 created.

azure-support: Thanks for the request. We've created a case: SR#2026-045678. Next steps: capacity validation (24-72h), then quota update & CR booking if capacity available. Please provide any expected start date and commitment term (monthly/quarterly). If you want guaranteed capacity, select the reservation option in the portal and we'll coordinate backend allocation.

nina: FYI, put a note about VM image / accelerated networking requirements. Some ND SKUs require specific image families and subscription registration. I can run the precheck scripts before we approve.

raj: Copying the precheck commands I used for validation:
```bash
az vm list-usage --location northeurope
az vm image list --offer microsoft-azure-nd --all --output table
# pseudo-command for quota request via cli
az support ticket create --problem-class "quota" --title "Quota & CR request NDv4/ND40rs northeurope" --description "Refer AZ-SR-2026-045678 / INC-2042"
```

sam: From load tests, linking the error snippet that shows port bind exhaustion:
```
ERROR: outbound connection failed: no available ephemeral ports
local_addr=10.42.3.22:44412
remote_addr=52.174.23.11:443
```

chris: Assigning ownership to @raj for Azure side and I'll own procurement/cost approvals. Raj — can you update INC-2042 with the SR number and expected ETA when you have it?

raj: On it. I'll update the ticket and ping Azure if we don't get capacity confirmation in 48h. Also adding a note to the Dedicated onboarding checklist to account for NAT gateway port sizing.

infra-bot: INC-2042 updated: linked SR#2026-045678, assignee raj, status: awaiting capacity validation.

azure-support: Quick note — if northeurope is capacity constrained we may propose an alternate region (westeurope or francecentral) for immediate CR. Let us know whether cross-region fallback is acceptable.

chris: Prefer northeurope but fallback to westeurope acceptable for initial burst. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
